//: Story Phase 2, chapter 1: The Man in the Bathtub. Main-deck positions: telescope (4,28), used from (5,28) facing left; starboard is the left rail.
ch1.hook: captain: The sun's getting low. Rounds done, rats done, ledger balanced.
captain[smug]: Nell reckons we raise the wreck-waters by morning. Maybe some honest plunder for a change.

ch1.hook.tutorial: When you have finished exploring, turn in for the night in your bed in the Captain's Quarters. The next chapter begins in the morning.
ch1.hook.title: A New Day

start: Your bed. A feather mattress, liberated from a governor's mansion. Real feathers, mostly.

then: captain: Not yet. There's always one more thing to shout at.

sleep.narrate: Morning on the Sapphire Sea. Sunlight on calm water, a warm wind in the sails...
...and aboard the Queen Anne's Revenge, a crew enjoying the most peaceful morning they will have for quite some time.

sleep: captain: Calm sea. Fair wind. Nothing on the horizon.
captain[smug]: Nothing can possibly go wrong today.

sleep.tutorial: A new day aboard. Talk to the crew and see what the morning brings.
sleep.title: Chapter 1

ch1.lookout: ned[surprised]: Captain! Something in the water! Off the starboard bow!
ned: A floating kind, Captain! A round-ish, white-ish, floating kind!
ned[concerned]: And it's... I think it's shouting.
captain[annoyed]: Somebody fetch me the telescope. And nobody shout back at it until we know what it is.

ch1.lookout.tutorial: The telescope stands at the starboard (left) rail, just forward of the main hatch. Face it and press {btn:confirm}.
ch1.lookout.title: Telescope

start: You put your eye to the telescope and sweep the water off the starboard bow...
Blue. Blue. More blue. A gull, looking pleased with itself.
captain[surprised]: There's a man in it.
captain: A large man. In a green coat. Paddling. With...
captain[disgusted]: ...are those sausages? He's paddling with two enormous sausages.

start.say: garrick: AHOOOY! AHOY THERE, VESSEL! Permission to approach, pending a mutually beneficial arrangement!
start.name: Voice from the Sea

start: ned: What is it, Captain? A stranded merchant?
captain: Could be. He's shouting like one.
bob[happy]: Or a really loud buoy!
brask: Is it one of them giant floating fruits? I heard they get them down south. Big as a barrel.
captain[annoyed]: It's a man. In a bathtub.
captain: Whatever he is, he's going to sink before he reaches us. That tub's riding low.

then: captain[determined]: Bring him alongside. Rook! A line!
captain: Leave him.
hale[concerned]: Captain.
captain[annoyed]: ...Fine. Bring him in. Rook! A line!
ned: Just the sausages, Captain.
captain[resigned]: ...Bring him in anyway. Rook! A line!

haul: rook[happy]: Coming about, Cap'n! Hold your sausages, mister!
garrick[delighted]: Ahhh. Timber underfoot. Now THIS is a ship.
garrick[businesslike]: Garrick Guzzlegut, at your service. Appraiser of treasures. Salvager of opportunities. Maritime businessman.
He presses a soggy square of card into your hand. The ink has run. It now reads 'GARR  GUZ  MARITI  BUS'.
garrick[pretend]: It's been a difficult quarter.
squawks: squawks[squawk]: SQUAWK! Captain! Captain! I leave for ONE morning flight—
squawks[insulting]: A walrus in a COAT! With SIDEBURNS! Throw it back, Captain, it's too big to eat!
garrick[annoyed]: Is the bird part of the ship's assets? Because I'd like to discuss depreciating it.
squawks[smug]: Captain Squawks. First mate of the air. Remember the name, walrus.
origin: captain: How does a man end up in a bathtub in the middle of the Sapphire Sea?
garrick[businesslike]: An excellent question, Captain. I've asked the sea the same thing several times. It never answers.
garrick: Six days ago I purchased a boat. A fine little sloop. At a tremendous discount.
garrick[pretend]: The seller described it as 'open-plan'. She went down before we cleared the harbour wall.
garrick: Fortunately the bathtub floated. It was the only part of the deal that performed.
garrick[greedy]: Oars, provisions and emergency capital. Diversification, Captain.

then: garrick[businesslike]: Formerly Senior Treasure Appraiser to the docks of Port Farthing. Finest docks on the coast.
captain: Formerly?
garrick[pretend]: There was a misunderstanding about the difference between 'appraising' a crown and 'wearing it home'.

choice.text: What happened to your last job?
then: garrick: I was let go. The harbourmaster called it theft. I called it 'asset relocation'.
garrick: We agreed to disagree. Then he agreed to throw me off the end of the dock.
garrick[delighted]: I can tell real gold from gilt by the smell. A ruby from a boiled sweet by the sound it makes on a tooth.
garrick: Put me in a room with any treasure in the world and I'll value it in under a minute.
captain: Can you swab a deck?
garrick[pretend]: ...I can supervise a deck being swabbed.

choice.text: Why shouldn't I throw you back?
then: garrick[businesslike]: Because, Captain, a ship with a treasure room needs a man who knows what's in it.
captain[surprised]: Who said I had a treasure room?
garrick[smug]: Every pirate ship has a treasure room. It's in the brochure.

decide: hale: Well, Captain? What do we do with him?

then: captain[annoyed]: Throw him back.
garrick[terrified]: Wait wait wait! A counter-offer! I'll work for half pay!
captain: You're not getting any pay.
garrick: Then I'll work for half of that!
hale[concerned]: Captain... we're three hands short since the fever. And look at the tub.
The bathtub gives a small, sad gurgle and settles lower in the water.
captain[resigned]: ...Fine. He stays. Provisionally.
captain: You'll work. Hard. For no pay.
garrick[businesslike]: I accept, provisionally, pending a review of the benefits package.
captain: There IS no benefits package.
garrick[smug]: Then I'll draft one.
captain: Lock him in the brig.
hale: The brig's full of Penhallow's luggage, Captain.
captain[surprised]: Penhallow brought LUGGAGE?
hale: Eleven trunks. He was very specific about them.
captain[resigned]: ...Then he works. Provisionally.

welcome: captain[determined]: Hear me, Guzzlegut. You're crew. Provisionally. Put one boot wrong and you're back in that bathtub.
garrick[delighted]: Understood, Captain! Welcome aboard, me!
garrick[offended]: My VESSEL comes with me. It has sentimental value. And a brass plate I haven't finished unscrewing.
captain[resigned]: ...Haul it up. Stow it by the bow.
hale[happy]: Three cheers for the new... whatever he is!
garrick[delighted]: Thank you, thank you! Drinks for everyone! On the house!
garrick: ...On this house. The captain's paying.
squawks[insulting]: SQUAWK! THROW HIM BACK! THROW HIM BACK WITH THE SAUSAGES!
